name: Zoho Invoice
summary: Zoho Invoice is a free invoicing app for up to two users, three projects and 500 invoices a year. Customers pay through connected payment gateways or its customer portal, and Zoho does not add fees to payments it passes through.

facts.text: The free plan allows up to two users, three projects and 500 invoices a year, and invoices carry Powered by Zoho Invoice branding.
Zoho deletes free account data after more than 180 days of inactivity, within the following 20 days, and notifies users beforehand.
Zoho says it adds no fees to payments you receive, though the payment gateway may charge processing fees.
Zoho states SOC 2 Type 2 compliance and ISO/IEC 27001 certification across its cloud services.
The pricing page names no paid plan and points growing businesses to Zoho Billing.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Up to 2 users, 3 projects, 500 invoices a year and up to 2 organizations under one Zoho account

hiddenCosts: Payment gateways charge their own processing fees.
Free invoices carry Zoho Invoice branding.
